classification.difficultyReason: Convert metres to centimetres and use the common ratio between object height and shadow length.

content.prompt: A vertical stick of length 30 cm casts a shadow of length 5 cm. Find the length of the shadow cast by a 1 metre ruler placed in the same position at the same time of day.

answer.worked:
The stick and ruler form similar right-angled triangles with their shadows: the sunlight makes the same angle with the ground at the same time of day. Convert $1\text{ m}=100\text{ cm}$. Let $s$ cm be the ruler's shadow length.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{s}{5}&=\frac{100}{30}\\s&=5\times\frac{100}{30}\\s&=\frac{50}{3}\end{align*}$$
The shadow is $16\frac23\text{ cm}$ long.
